note: Experiment 2 prints no wiring: Experiment 1's text, which runs onto printed p.73 (PDF p.79), ends just above the Experiment 2 heading with 'Leave the Binary Counter on the MINIVAC for Experiment 2.', so as_printed and wires are the Experiment 1 list printed on p.72 (PDF p.78), image-checked against programs.json wiresEffective, 44 wires. ER-22 (errata.pdf p.3, 'page 73') reads 'Experiment 2 — use the above circuit if necessary.'; the above circuit is the alternate counter (ER-ALTCOUNTER). It is a conditional substitution, not a wire edit, so errata_applied is empty and this fixture runs the printed counter. The lamp patterns for 2 and for 010 combine p.73's displayed number with p.72's 'Binary output lights 4, 5 and 6' readings. For 5, p.73 prints no lamp pattern; lights 4 and 6 come from row 11 of the p.71 SEQUENCE OF OPERATIONS chart, which prints Flip-Flop B = 1 (a misprint, programs.md IV-EXP1), so light 5 is not asserted at count 5, as in IV-EXP1-SLOW. The counter is started from power-on; p.73 does not print the starting state, so none is asserted. Press and release timing follows IV-EXP1-SLOW; the page prints no timing. Release steps carry the counter collapse tag.
